comment:
The tower now builds fully (v2: the toolkit roof is skipped in build.mjs because its preset crashes on these stepped flat tops; keep that fallback, and keep the massing, setbacks, piers and wings exactly). It reads as 30 Rock; three things for the hero aerial at dusk:
1. THE CROWN: the GE-era red sign is too small to see from the air. On BOTH the north and the south faces near the top (about y 200-215, on the broad flanks), make big illuminated red letters "GE" in a round monogram style, each glyph about 9-11 tall and 1 deep, red concrete faced with red stained glass backed by glowstone/shroomlight so they glow, centred on the face; the existing small sign can go.
2. TOP OF THE ROCK: the three topmost tiers (the 67th-70th floor decks) should read from above as observation decks: pale stone deck floors, continuous glass-pane parapets around each tier edge, a few lit lanterns, the narrow top roof with its low mechanical penthouse and slim mast with a red aircraft light.
3. FLOODLIGHT the crown: hidden light blocks (shroomlight or glowstone under slabs/trapdoors, or light blocks) along the ledges of the top six setbacks, so the upper limestone glows warm against the dusk sky.
Do not change anything below y 150 except the light scatter.
summary: The GE sign is now big glowing red letters, 11 tall and 19 wide, on both the north and south flanks at y198-208. The setback ledges from y196 up have floodlight rows: unbroken rows of shroomlight in the decks, and uplights at the foot of each pier on the 212/218 ledges. Shroomlight floodlight rows line the three Top of the Rock decks, and the mast has a red aircraft light. Nothing below y196 changed: build.nbt was rebuilt by the generator, and a diff against v2.nbt shows changes only at y196-244.
applied: 1 GE sign: parts/ge-sign.mjs now draws its own rounded letters (2-block strokes) in place of the small plaque letters. G is 9x11 and E 7x11, 1 deep, red_stained_glass in the face line over the shroomlight backing so they glow. They are centred on the flank (x80..98, y198..208) on both the north face (z12) and the south face (z43). Each face is mirrored so it reads GE from the street there; the north and back elevations both show it clearly. The old small sign is gone.

2 Top of the Rock: the decks at y224 and y228 and the top roof at y232 already had smooth_stone floors, polished_andesite curbs, continuous 2-high glass-pane parapets and lanterns every 6; I checked in a close-up that they read from above. Each of the three decks now also has a row of shroomlight along the foot of the tier above (or the penthouse), and a red aircraft light sits on the mast head (red_stained_glass over a shroomlight in the bars). The penthouse and slim mast are unchanged.

3 Floodlights: every setback ledge from y196 up (196, 202, 209, 216, 222) now has an unbroken shroomlight row flush in its deck against the wall above, where before it was every 2nd cell. The 212 and 218 ledges are the massing's own tops, so lights in the deck were refused there; each instead got a shroomlight uplight at the foot of every pier (even x), 44 per ledge, on the north and south flanks.
The anti-spawn pass was re-run: it now places 435 lanterns and finds no unlit open spot. Only lantern spots above y196 moved.
skipped: Red concrete in the letters: a letter 1 block deep can't be red concrete and also have red glass on its front, so I made the letters red_stained_glass over shroomlight (lit from behind), the nearest thing to what you described.
A round monogram outline (a ring like the GE logo): the 13-row sign band can't hold a ring around both letters at 9-11 rows tall, so the round style is in the rounded corners of the letters instead.

Hiding the lights under slabs or trapdoors: a slab or trapdoor over a light blocks its glow upward in 1.21.1, so the light would not reach the wall. The floodlights stay as shroomlight flush in the decks, plus low uplights at the pier feet on 212/218. In the render they show as a warm line along each ledge.
